name: MSG_USE
meaning: kick from the Wolf (end of state 0xD2): push (no FrozenRiver only)

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: returns 0x1F CTX_ICECUBE to the Wolf when no FrozenRiver and the Wolf is at most 100 above the cube origin

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: attach to the sender joint, state 0

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach, SetPosition unless flags bit1, state 2

name: MSG_RIVER_CARGO_END
meaning: returns 1, no effect (sent by FrozenRiver_MoveCargo at the last path node; meaning inferred)
